content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where financial isolation and platform restrictions are a harsh reality, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-trap-most-creators-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-what-actually-how-6|Digital Product]] creators face significant hurdles in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-honest-side-2|setting]] up online stores that can accept payments securely. The absence of Stripe and other conventional payment gateways forces entrepreneurs to seek alternative solutions, making the deployment of a digital store on free hosting services like Cloudflare Pages an attractive option.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure proposed by COREMERCH, specifically Stack 01 and Stack 02, offers a sovereign digital commerce solution. By leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, creators can bypass traditional payment gateways. This setup ensures data ownership and the ability to sell digital products without relying on restricted platforms, thereby circumventing the limitations imposed by Stripe's unavailability in certain regions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you need to have a clear understanding of your product offerings, target audience, and the technical requirements for setting up your store. This includes choosing between Stack 01, which can be deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, and Stack 02, which is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Understanding the difference between these stacks and their respective benefits is crucial for making an informed decision that aligns with your business needs and technical capabilities.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a competitive 0.5% fee. This integration allows for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, ensuring a seamless transaction process. For delivery, utilizing Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage enables instant product delivery upon successful payment confirmation. Configuring these components correctly is essential for a smooth and reliable customer experience.
Deploy your digital store in as little as 4-6 hours with Stack 01.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up and your payment and delivery pipelines are configured, you can go live. The first transaction is a milestone, as it tests the entire infrastructure. With Stack 02, the end-to-end testing done by COREMERCH before handoff ensures that your store is ready for transactions. Monitoring this first transaction closely will help you identify any issues and make necessary adjustments to optimize your store's performance and customer satisfaction.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, the focus shifts to scaling your digital store. This involves optimizing your backend logic for increased traffic, ensuring your hosting can handle more visitors, and possibly expanding your product offerings. The scalability of your infrastructure, particularly with solutions like Cloudflare Pages and Supabase, allows for growth without significant additional costs, making your digital commerce venture more sustainable and profitable in the long run.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can use COREMERCH's Stack 01, which combines GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. This setup allows you to host your store, manage backend logic, and process crypto payments without any subscription fees, other than the 0.5% transaction fee charged by NOWPayments. By following the Sovereign Blueprint, you can deploy your store in 4-6 hours, giving you a rapid entry into the digital commerce space.
Scale your store without significant additional costs using Cloudflare Pages and Supabase.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking for a more comprehensive solution with additional features and support, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a Stack 02 deployment in 48 hours, including Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration. This stack is end-to-end tested and comes with 30-day support, ensuring a smooth and reliable operation. You can explore more about this and other products at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, finding the perfect fit for your digital commerce needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store, start by selecting your hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. After configuring your payment pipeline, set up your product delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, test your store end-to-end to ensure all components are working seamlessly together, and then you can launch your digital store and start selling your products.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02?

Stack 01 is deployed in 4-6 hours and includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, while Stack 02, deployed in 48 hours, includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, with additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for free?
Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages offer free hosting for your digital product store, allowing you to sell digital products without incurring hosting costs.
How does NOWPayments handle crypto transactions?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and automatically verifies transactions on-chain, charging a 0.5% fee per transaction, with no need for KYC or a buyer account.
What kind of support does COREMERCH offer?
COREMERCH offers 30-day support for its Edge Commerce Stack, ensuring that any issues with your store's setup or operation are addressed promptly.
Is my data secure with COREMERCH's infrastructure?
With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you own all your data. The company has no access to your store or customer data after deployment, ensuring your sovereignty over your digital commerce operations.
